reason: #623 first item: e2e/error-paths-423.spec.ts's partial Reset all data test read the storage keys while the autosave that resetAll() schedules 400 ms later could still land, so on a slow runner one key went and one arrived and the count check failed on both attempts. The test now flushes the pending autosave and waits for the document record before reading the keys, and checks that exactly the remembered storage mode was removed, nothing arrived, and the document record whose removal was refused stays. Test only; no product change.
